question: Can the audited parameterized-inheritance capability be made DURABLE and PROMOTABLE in the shipping kernel path (src/spider) -- a pre-freeze arm-differentiation certificate showing that the SHIPPED kernel executes an inherited parameterized mechanism (known-positive: induction observation -> parameterized distillation -> resolve to EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound, non-null action -> execute against the fixture -> verify) AND refuses a known-negative binding (missing-parameter / out-of-support / wrong-intent) with a recorded reason and a null action, with unit tests, an accounting check that the inherited-path counters increment, and the kernel identity bound at freeze -- so that the carrier actually lands in main through the pinned Product promotion path without manually copying experiment code?
hypothesis: Installing the audited parameterized-inheritance carrier kernel (research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440/harness/audited_spider/kernel.py, git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796, sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72) BYTE-IDENTICALLY at the shipping kernel path src/spider/kernel.py -- with src/spider/models.py and src/spider/registry.py already byte-identical to the carrier's versions (sha256 338aaf4d7ba0e31f7a5fe8a47abdbb2ea52d9c1c4ef0ce014f2b809b9a2a9b78 and 51fb440d3827f21cccb5f77ad17dc0e76ccdbc2d52d7b05044cd821bb8a9322c) and src/spider/__init__.py kept as the shipped public surface (sha256 3d173722b38c5130a5145b1558412a399f851c8ed4fbf2ddfa4022e4cb2b5a77) -- makes the shipped package (a) execute the inherited parameterized round trip on the SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 fixture on all six families (distill_parameterized -> resolve EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound, non-null held-out identifier -> deterministic fixture execute status 200 -> verify true), (b) refuse the full declared negative set (out-of-support / missing-parameter / wrong-intent: 24/24) with a recorded reason and a null bound action, (c) keep the inherited-path counters honest (retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_attempts increment exactly as declared), (d) keep the pre-existing regression suite green under the canonical discovery invocation, and (e) preserve the installed-kernel identity equal to the frozen carrier hash, so that the resulting src/ + tests/ delta is promotable by the pinned Product promotion workflow (.github/workflows/product-promote.yml) without manually copying experiment code into main. The literal-only baseline (pre-install shipped kernel, blob cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50, sha256 46929b3a951df48d7f9d1fd850871073c0d91c1868aa117e13d389fe274e8d61) has no distill_parameterized() and therefore cannot satisfy the positive arm; the treatment is the audited parameterized path placed at the shipping position.
falsifier: Any of: (1) C1 identity binding fails -- the installed src/spider/kernel.py sha256 != 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72 or git blob != b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796, or any frozen artifact deviates from its freeze.json.artifact_hashes entry; (2) C2 positive roundtrip fails -- AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP does not pass 6/6 (resolution != EXECUTABLE, bound action null, bound identifier != expected held-out identifier, fixture execute status != 200, or verify != true on any family); (3) C3 negative roundtrip fails -- any of the 24 declared negatives resolves EXECUTABLE, or has a non-null bound action, or has an empty reason (per-category refusal rates < 1.0); (4) C4 treatment contrast fails -- AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST real contrast_rate == 0.0 on all families, or NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT degenerate variant is NOT detected (degenerate contrast_rate != 0.0); (5) C5 accounting fidelity fails -- scripted-trajectory max relative error > 0.01, or the real inherited-path increments are not exactly {retrieval_calls: 3, verification_calls: 2, repair_attempts: 1}; (6) C6 literal control fails -- B-LITERAL-KERNEL held_out_executable_count > 0; (7) C7 promotability fails after a C1-passing byte-exact install -- the pre-existing tests/test_kernel.py or the EXECUTE-added shipping-path unit tests fail under the canonical discovery invocation, or `python -m compileall -q src scripts` fails. Any C2/C7 failure means the audited carrier, once installed at the shipping position, is not promotable in its audited form.

baselines.description: Literal-only kernel ablation (pre-repair semantics, preserved unchanged inside the carrier): SpiderKernel.distill() creates literal mechanisms at confidence 0.5 (< min_confidence 0.8) with no parameter_slots; on the parameterized held-out tasks this must produce 0 EXECUTABLE (UNKNOWN/EXPLORE). This isolates the contribution of the parameterized distill_parameterized path and is exactly the behavior of the current shipped kernel (blob cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50). Expected: held_out_executable_count == 0.

Retrieval-shaped comparator: the literal action of the K=5 structurally nearest induction observation (Jaccard over flattened intent/state/action key paths, from the frozen fixture reconstruction), executed with no parameter binding and no support re-check. Used only inside AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST to show the treatment's re-bound parameterized action differs from the retrieved literal action (contrast on at least one family). Non-gating for the promotion decision.

Baseline identity of the shipping kernel BEFORE install: src/spider/kernel.py git blob cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50, sha256 46929b3a951df48d7f9d1fd850871073c0d91c1868aa117e13d389fe274e8d61 (literal-only: no distill_parameterized, no rebind, no TrajectoryCounters). Recorded so the identity change is unambiguous, so baseline_identifiability is provable, and so a negative outcome can revert the Product branch to this exact state.

positive_control.description: Known-positive arm-differentiation control. For each of the six SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 families, distill_parameterized() is induced from the four induction observations, resolve() is called on the stable context with the held-out identifier keyed by the mechanism's OWN inferred slot names, and the bound action is executed against the deterministic fixture and verified by verify(). Parameter dictionaries are keyed by the audited carrier's inferred slot names (e.g. F2-QUERY-ID infers the slot 'q' from the leaf 'params.q'); family slot_keys are used only to locate the held-out VALUES. This rule was established by the pre-freeze probe (section 7 of prereg.md) and is part of the frozen measurement.
positive_control.expected_behavior: 6/6 families: resolution EXECUTABLE, bound_action non-null, bound identifier == the expected held-out identifier for that family, fixture execute status == 200, verify == true; in_support_executable_rate == 1.0 and held_out_binding_correct_rate == 1.0.

null_control.description: Degenerate zero-contrast null. The SAME contrast instrument used for AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST is run with the comparator action on BOTH sides (comparator-vs-itself). A naive/insensitive contrast instrument would still report a pass; a sensitive one reports degenerate contrast_rate == 0.0 and flags the degenerate variant.
null_control.expected_behavior: degenerate_variant contrast_rate == 0.0 and degenerate_variant_detected == true (the zero-contrast degenerate arm must FAIL the contrast check).

measurement_validity: Credential-free, deterministic, standard-library-only: the certificate, fixture and accounting path use no model, no browser, no network and no database. Verified environment: Python 3.12.15, git 2.55.0 (probe run 2026-10-10).

DETERMINISM DISCLOSURE (not a discovery experiment): the confirmatory measurement is deterministic because the installed bytes are PINNED to the frozen audited carrier hash. DESIGN therefore already executed the pre-freeze arm-differentiation certificate as the mandatory v2 treatment-liveness satisfiability probe against a byte-faithful sandbox replica of the REAL shipping tree (real src/spider/__init__.py, models.py, registry.py and the carrier kernel at the kernel position). The probe artifacts, full driver source, reproduction commands and observed values are embedded in prereg.md section 7 (probe.py sha256 ad7ad7773779ce69b68122a362c9194f24025f0a02b0bfad8b9c1c39e2291563; probe_results.json sha256 57bb5713b915a17ebe8b8f1aa7d8c8ed2e70be404ac03d8e19386acd0de1ea95; probe_results_preinstall.json sha256 6b826e2b1c3506251522345f1cbfedcd513dd0a4c5574d72df76b7cb1b98c51e; probe_results_drift.json sha256 b2ce9450d33a528e3ac2970cdc168dba858cedae3adc7e8a4734d3950abefb01). EXECUTE re-runs the identical certificate against the ACTUAL installed src/spider package as the confirmatory measurement; a deviation between the probe expectation and the EXECUTE observation is a measurement-invalidity signal (or BLOCKED if the file cannot be installed), never a silent pass. Downstream agents must not mistake this deterministic engineering confirmation for new causal evidence about web behavior.

Identity binding (gate): the installed src/spider/kernel.py must equal the frozen carrier artifact byte-for-byte: sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72, git blob b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796. The carrier's models.py (338aaf4d...) and registry.py (51fb440d...) are already byte-identical to the shipped src/spider/models.py and src/spider/registry.py (same blobs f08608c3... and 986317f7...), so the only production module that changes is the kernel. The carrier package __init__.py is EMPTY and is NOT used at install; the shipped __init__.py (3d173722...) is bound and stays the package surface. TrajectoryCounters is importable from spider.kernel (module scope); adding a package-level re-export is explicitly out of scope.

Freeze artifacts are immutable interpretation dependencies for this transaction: carrier kernel/models/registry (treatment source AND required installed-identity target for the kernel), the SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 fixture reconstruction (research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128/harness/fixture.py, sha256 b0ffcbba5041871f58408c4766268b31bb84cb81ccef965cd944c486fd4dd6cf), the shipped import dependencies src/spider/models.py and src/spider/registry.py, the shipped public surface src/spider/__init__.py (deliberately kept byte-identical), and the pre-existing regression suite tests/test_kernel.py (sha256 ff9c1561c4169d306fba56d52442546a3bbfdab11d3ab56c51d7369309e9c0b6). EXECUTE must not modify them. src/spider/kernel.py is deliberately NOT a freeze artifact because EXECUTE replaces its content; its post-install identity is pinned by decision_rule C1 and its pre-install baseline is recorded as B-SHIPPED-PRE-INSTALL.

Known-negative categories: out-of-support identifiers (empty, whitespace, slash, and out-of-grammar slot pairs), missing required parameters, and wrong intent. Every negative must yield a non-EXECUTABLE status (EXPLORE or UNKNOWN), bound_action == null, and a non-empty recorded reason; per-category refusal rates are reported and must all be 1.0. Parameter keys in negative cases are likewise mapped to the mechanism's inferred slot names (probe pin: single-parameter cases pass the value under the mechanism's slot name).

Accounting honesty (PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY): (a) a seeded 5-step scripted trajectory with a declared ground truth over all eight counters requires max relative error <= 0.01; (b) a real inherited-path exercise on family F1 (resolve-EXECUTABLE + verify + refused-resolve + rebind + verify) must increment retrieval_calls by exactly 3, verification_calls by exactly 2 and repair_attempts by exactly 1. The model_calls/model_tokens events in (a) are an explicitly injected labeled synthetic event; the experiment makes no model calls.

Equal tooling and no stochastic arm-to-arm comparison: the treatment, the literal ablation, the retrieval comparator and the degenerate null consume the same frozen fixture and the same kernel surface in one deterministic process (same Python, same git, same machine).

Canonical regression invocation: the repository runs tests as `PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` (see .github/workflows/ci.yml and .github/workflows/product-promote.yml). The CPython unittest runner emits its protocol on stderr; certificate runners must capture both streams. tests/ has no __init__.py, so module-path invocation is not canonical. The DESIGN probe confirmed the pre-existing tests/test_kernel.py passes both pre-install (against the shipped tree) and post-install (against the sandbox replica) under the canonical invocation.

Promotion-path dependency (operational, recorded for downstream): .github/workflows/product-promote.yml promotes ONLY the delta over allowed_code_roots ([src, tests, sdk, pyproject.toml]) between execution_checkpoint.json.pre_execute_sha (written automatically by scripts/record_execution_base.py before EXECUTE) and the commit that CREATED verdict.json, via `git apply --index --3way` onto current main, then runs `python -m compileall -q src scripts`, `python scripts/validate_repo.py` and the canonical unittest discovery before committing. EXECUTE must therefore keep the code-root delta minimal and exclusive: ONLY src/spider/kernel.py replaced and tests/test_ship_kernel.py added; nothing else under src/, tests/, sdk/ or pyproject.toml may change. If main has diverged in src/spider since the execution base, the 3-way apply can conflict and promotion hard-stops. This is an operational dependency, not a scientific falsifier.

The unit tests are NOT the decision instrument: the certificate (AD-* / PC-* / NC-* / B-LITERAL / AD-IDENTITY) is the decision instrument and its raw JSON is written by the certificate runner. The EXECUTE-added unit test module is a secondary regression surface; even if it were vacuous, C2-C6 would still gate the decision from the certificate JSON (which AUDIT recomputes from raw evidence).

No-residue rule: on FALSIFIES/MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED the Product branch tree must not keep the installed kernel; revert_product_reject.py reverts the code-root delta to pre_execute_sha (B-SHIPPED-PRE-INSTALL, sha256 46929b3a...).

decision_rule.C1_identity_binding: PASS iff: installed src/spider/kernel.py sha256 == 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72 AND git blob == b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796, AND every frozen artifact still matches its freeze.json.artifact_hashes entry.
decision_rule.C2_positive_roundtrip: PASS iff AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP passes on 6/6 families (resolution EXECUTABLE, bound_action non-null, bound identifier == expected held-out identifier, fixture execute status == 200, verify == true).
decision_rule.C3_negative_roundtrip: PASS iff AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP refusal_rate == 1.0 over all 24 negative cases, with every case non-EXECUTABLE, bound_action null, and a non-empty reason; per-category rates (out-of-support, missing-parameter, wrong-intent) all 1.0.
decision_rule.C4_treatment_contrast: PASS iff AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST real contrast_rate > 0.0 on at least one family AND NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT degenerate variant is detected (degenerate contrast_rate == 0.0, degenerate_variant_detected == true).
decision_rule.C5_accounting_fidelity: PASS iff PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY: scripted-trajectory max relative error <= 0.01 AND inherited-path increments == exactly {retrieval_calls: 3, verification_calls: 2, repair_attempts: 1}.
decision_rule.C7_promotability_tests: PASS iff after the byte-exact install the pre-existing tests/test_kernel.py passes under the canonical discovery invocation, the EXECUTE-added shipping-path unit tests (tests/test_ship_kernel.py) pass, and `python -m compileall -q src scripts` returns 0. (python scripts/validate_repo.py is additionally exercised by the promotion workflow on main.)

OVERALL_OUTCOME.SUPPORTS: C1 through C7 all PASS. status=COMPLETE; the audited capability is installed at the shipping position and the packet is promotion-ready; the packet recommends promote_to_product=true (the DIRECTOR verdict decides; PRODUCT_CORE requires Product lane, PASS audit and promotion intent).
OVERALL_OUTCOME.FALSIFIES: C2 fails after a C1-passing byte-exact install, or C7 fails after a C1-passing byte-exact install. status=COMPLETE. The audited carrier, once installed at the shipping position, cannot carry the inherited-parameterized round trip and/or is incompatible with the shipping test/compile surface; it is not promotable in its audited form. Reachability is not vacuous: the DESIGN pre-install probe (probe_results_preinstall.json) shows the unmodified shipped kernel fails C2 (no distill_parameterized) and C1 (hash 46929b3a != 718efa6a), and the drift probe (probe_results_drift.json) shows C1 detects any byte drift.
OVERALL_OUTCOME.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: C1 fails (identity/binding violated or a frozen artifact changed), or C3, C4, C5 or C6 fails (the arm-differentiation instrumentation does not behave as frozen). status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Do not promote; repair the instrumentation and re-run under a new frozen packet. This must never be recorded as a scientific negative, and the v1 defect in which a certificate gate was asserted but not enforced must not recur.
OVERALL_OUTCOME.BLOCKED: Infrastructure/prerequisite failure independent of the hypothesis: src/ not writable within the Product execute scope, the checker cannot run in the environment, or install cannot be performed. status=BLOCKED. Never encode this as FALSIFIES.

product_consequence_positive: The audited parameterized-inheritance carrier is installed byte-identically at src/spider/kernel.py and the arm-differentiation certificate plus unit tests pass on the shipped package, so the EXECUTE packet supports promotion. DIRECTOR may advance C-PARAM-INHERIT to PRODUCT_CORE with promote_to_product=true (finalize_lane.py requires a PASS audit, the Product lane, and promotion intent for that status; SHIPPED is post-promotion and is not a lane-Director status). The pinned Product promotion workflow (product-promote.yml) then applies ONLY the audited src/ + tests/ delta (src/spider/kernel.py plus tests/test_ship_kernel.py) between pre_execute_sha and the verdict-creation commit onto current main, runs compileall/validate_repo/the canonical unit-test discovery, and commits 'product: promote audited EXP-PRODUCT-37999047472' -- no manual copying of experiment code into main. Readiness condition (1) for the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark is cleared and the program's central 'audited but never shipped' gap is closed.
product_consequence_negative: No promotion. The installed kernel is reverted to the frozen baseline identity B-SHIPPED-PRE-INSTALL (blob cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50, sha256 46929b3a951df48d7f9d1fd850871073c0d91c1868aa117e13d389fe274e8d61) via revert_product_reject.py so the Product branch tree carries no residue, and C-PARAM-INHERIT retains its prior effective epistemic status (EXPERIMENTAL). If the outcome is FALSIFIES, the audited carrier is not promotable in its current form and the next action is a bounded integration-defect diagnosis identifying the exact incompatibility (positive round trip at the shipping position, or shipping test/compile surface incompatibility) before any re-port. If the outcome is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, the arm-differentiation instrumentation (not the capability) is at fault and must be repaired and re-run under a new frozen packet.
estimated_cost: Low. Pure determinism with the standard library: no model calls, no browser, no network, no GPU, no cloud. The certificate over 6 families and 24 negative cases plus accounting and regression checks completes in seconds (probe total wall time < 5 s). EXECUTE writes the installed kernel, one new unit-test module, a certificate runner, the fixture reconstruction and raw certificate JSON; well under 60 seconds wall-clock and negligible resource cost.
expected_information_gain: High for the program, bounded and explicitly disclosed for the claim. Program value: this is the first packet designed to convert the two audit-PASS C-PARAM-INHERIT packets (EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 live path; EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128 arm-differentiation certificate) into a DURABLE, PROMOTED shipped state, and it exercises the pinned Product promotion path end-to-end. It directly closes readiness condition (1) -- the highest-leverage open blocker identified by the Global Research Director -- and unblocks the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark and first-party C-PRODUCT-ECON economics. Claim-level information gain is bounded and disclosed: because the installed bytes are pinned to the frozen audited carrier, the certificate is deterministic and was already demonstrated as the pre-freeze satisfiability probe, so this experiment is a durability/integration/promotion confirmation, not a new causal discovery about web behavior. The residual uncertainty it tests is real and has repeatedly blocked the program: whether the audited capability survives installation at the shipping position and the repository's promotion checks (import surface, identity, regression suite, compileall, validate_repo) without manual intervention, and whether the decision machinery detects failure when the state is NOT installed. A negative result would localize an integration defect that has so far only been re-discovered, never diagnosed.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every decision branch is reachable and no branch is empty. SUPPORTS is reachable: the DESIGN satisfiability probe (probe_results.json, sha256 57bb5713...) produced PASS on all eight probes (AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP 6/6, AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP 24/24, AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST real 1.0 + degenerate detected, PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY scripted 0.0 + inherited {3,2,1}, B-LITERAL-KERNEL 0, AD-IDENTITY-BINDING match, PKG-TESTS green, COMPILEALL 0) with the frozen carrier laid at the shipping position inside a byte-faithful replica of the real tree. FALSIFIES is reachable and was EMPIRICALLY demonstrated pre-freeze: (a) probe_results_preinstall.json (sha256 6b826e2b...) shows the current shipped kernel has no distill_parameterized and fails C2 on all six families, and fails C1 (46929b3a != 718efa6a) -- i.e. the certificate detects the not-installed state rather than vacously passing; (b) C7 observes, not assumes, the regression suite: any regression or compile failure after a C1-passing install yields FALSIFIES (the EXECUTE-added test module is new, unpinned code). MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable: probe_results_drift.json (sha256 b2ce9450...) demonstrates C1 detects a single-byte drift of the installed kernel (observed a2f2702c... != required 718efa6a...), and the degenerate zero-contrast null is instrumented to FAIL on a no-difference certificate (NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT detected == true only when degenerate rate == 0.0). BLOCKED is reachable on scope/environment/install failure. The certificate runner computes all checks unconditionally; the SUPPORTS condition is a conjunction over C1-C7 with no vacuous term.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: All prerequisites exist and were exercised at DESIGN. Python 3.12.15 and git 2.55.0 present (probe ran on them). The certificate is standard-library-only and credential-free (no model, browser, network or database), so there is no external substrate prerequisite. The Product execute scope permits writing src/ and tests/ (research/lanes/registry.json product.allowed_code_roots = [src, tests, sdk, pyproject.toml]; check_scope.py execute prefixes include the experiment dir plus those roots). Every freeze artifact exists at freeze time (verified sha256 in prereg.md section 6). execution_checkpoint.json (with pre_execute_sha) is written automatically before EXECUTE by scripts/record_execution_base.py. The canonical test invocation, compileall, the certificate and the preinstall/drift probes all ran successfully during DESIGN. The only module that changes, src/spider/kernel.py, is intentionally NOT a freeze artifact because EXECUTE must replace its content; its required post-install identity is pinned to the frozen carrier hash via C1 and its pre-install identity is recorded as B-SHIPPED-PRE-INSTALL.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The treatment and every comparator are distinct, observable objects, and the baseline sits at its floor, not a ceiling. B-LITERAL-KERNEL (literal distill at confidence 0.5 vs min_confidence 0.8) yields 0 EXECUTABLE on the parameterized held-out tasks while the treatment yields EXECUTABLE with correctly bound held-out identifiers (probe: 0 vs 6/6, executable_rate 0.0 vs 1.0). The pre-install shipping kernel is a different git blob (cfec9866...) from the installed carrier (b15ed848...), so the pre/post identity contrast is unambiguous and was measured in both directions (probe_results.json vs probe_results_preinstall.json). B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED returns the literal nearest-observation action, which the probe verified differs from the treatment's re-bound action on all six families (real contrast_rate 1.0), while the degenerate comparator-vs-itself contrast is exactly 0.0 and detected. No arm sits at a success ceiling that would mask a difference: the literal arm is pinned at 0 EXECUTABLE, giving the measurement genuine dynamic range; there is no arithmetic or identity overlap between treatment and comparators.

control_sensitivity.reason: Each control fires at its required value and can also fail (both directions demonstrated). Positive control: AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP fired 6/6 (in_support_executable_rate 1.0, held_out_binding_correct_rate 1.0, execute 200, verify true per family) on the installed replica AND FAILED 0/6 on the unmodified shipped tree (preinstall probe records the AttributeError per family) -- proving the control discriminates between the two states. Negative control: AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP refused 24/24 (refusal_rate 1.0) with null actions and recorded reasons across all categories. The degenerate zero-contrast null NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT was DETECTED as a failure (rate 0.0, detected true), demonstrating the contrast instrument is sensitive to a no-difference certificate rather than trivially passing. PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY separated exact counters (max relative error 0.0 vs threshold 0.01; inherited increments exactly {3,2,1}) and reports, not hides, when TrajectoryCounters is unavailable (preinstall probe). B-LITERAL-KERNEL produced exactly 0 EXECUTABLE on both trees. AD-IDENTITY-BINDING both passed on the replica and FAILED on the unmodified tree, and the drift probe proves single-byte detection. No control is insensitive.

treatment_liveness.reason: REQUIRED v2 treatment-liveness demonstration, executed at DESIGN as a cheap, non-outcome-bearing satisfiability probe. The frozen audited carrier kernel (sha256 718efa6a..., blob b15ed848...) was laid at the shipping kernel position inside a byte-faithful sandbox replica of the REAL shipping tree (real src/spider/__init__.py 3d173722..., real models.py, real registry.py; only kernel.py replaced), and the ARM-DIFFERENTIATION-CERTIFICATE-v2 was run against it plus the canonical regression invocation. Observed (probe_results.json): AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP PASS 6/6 (slots per family, confidence 0.9, EXECUTABLE, binding correct, execute 200, verify true; including the audited slot-naming convention F2->'q' handled by keying params to mechanism slots); AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP PASS 24/24 (per-kind rates all 1.0); AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST PASS (real 1.0, degenerate detected); PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY PASS (scripted max relative error 0.0; inherited increments retrieval_calls 3, verification_calls 2, repair_attempts 1); B-LITERAL-KERNEL PASS (0 EXECUTABLE); AD-IDENTITY-BINDING PASS (installed hash == frozen carrier hash, blob b15ed848..., pre/post differ); PKG-TESTS PASS (tests/test_kernel.py green under canonical `PYTHONPATH=<pkg> python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`); COMPILEALL PASS (rc 0). The treatment is structurally live at the shipping position and is not a ceiling/empty arm. Exact reproduction commands, the full driver source (probe.py, sha256 ad7ad777...) and observed values are in prereg.md section 7; EXECUTE re-runs the identical certificate against the real installed package as the confirmatory measurement.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: Eight mutable local interpretation dependencies are bound; all exist as repository files and none is a path EXECUTE must mutate. (1-3) The audited carrier kernel.py (treatment source AND the required installed-identity target), models.py and registry.py. (4) The SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 fixture reconstruction fixture.py (sha256 b0ffcbba...). (5-7) The shipped import dependencies src/spider/models.py and src/spider/registry.py, and the shipped public surface src/spider/__init__.py (which must remain byte-identical so the package surface does not drift). (8) The pre-existing regression suite tests/test_kernel.py, bound so it cannot be weakened. src/spider/kernel.py is deliberately excluded because EXECUTE replaces its content; its post-install identity is instead pinned by decision_rule C1 to the frozen carrier hash, and its pre-install baseline (sha256 46929b3a..., blob cfec9866...) is recorded as B-SHIPPED-PRE-INSTALL for reversion. The certificate runner, the fixture reconstruction copy and raw evidence written by EXECUTE are derived artifacts, not interpretation dependencies. All paths are repository-relative with no absolute or '..' components.
